verdict.rationale: Gazebo ships an official `gz` CLI. Docs show launching with `gz sim shapes.sdf`, headless server-only mode via `-s` and GUI-only mode via `-g`. The GitHub repo advertises extensive command line tools for simulation introspection and control, which together cover scriptable, agent-drivable use of the simulator. missing for 10: evidence of agent-friendly CLI traits such as machine-readable/JSON output or non-interactive automation guidance, detailed command reference documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI tooling.
